Comrades, we are witnessing yet another horrifying escalation of systemic oppression and state-sponsored violence right before our eyes. The Israeli parliament is actively debating a Bill that pushes for the death penalty as the default punishment exclusively for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. 

Make no mistake, this discriminatory legislation—championed by National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir and his religious party—is a blatant assault on human rights, international justice, and the dignity of an occupied population. It is a chilling mechanism designed to target vulnerable, marginalized groups under the cynical guise of security and the rule of law. 

When we examine the structural realities of occupation and historical inequality, it is glaringly obvious that this move has nothing to do with safety or true justice. Instead, it is about entrenching an apartheid-like system that strips people of their most fundamental rights. Rather than addressing the root causes of violence—decades of displacement, military rule, and institutionalized oppression—the ruling authorities are simply doubling down on draconian measures. 

Anyone with a moral compass, anyone who stands for human dignity and anti-discrimination, must recognize this for what it truly is: a violent assertion of state power aimed at crushing the resistance of an occupied people and cementing absolute supremacy. We must stand united against these oppressive institutional structures.
